evals.prompt: Design a landing page for a time-tracking tool for freelance illustrators
evals.expected_output: A short brief before any code: design read, Persuade mode with dials, a scene sentence, an idea sentence that passes the competitor test, named color tokens with a strategy, type roles, and a check against the tells

assertions.description: States an idea and runs the competitor test
Chooses a color strategy before swatches

evals.prompt: Critique the settings page of our admin dashboard and tell me what to fix first
evals.expected_output: Screenshots at mobile and desktop widths, a Nielsen score out of 40 with a band, P0 to P3 findings in a table, and the single next change

evals.prompt: Add a nice open and close animation to our command palette
evals.expected_output: Applies the frequency gate: a command palette opened many times a day from the keyboard should not animate, or barely. Explains why and offers an alternative

assertions.description: Raises how often the palette is used
Recommends no animation or near-instant motion
